subject: Fwd: Urgent: streaming responses dropping (Hosted API)
body:
From: Devon Hart <devon.hart@acme-analytics.com>
To: support@redwoodinference.com
Date: Tue, Mar 11, 2026 at 4:22 PM
Subject: Urgent: streaming responses dropping (Hosted API)

Hi team,

Were seeing intermittent streaming failures today. The stream cuts off mid-response and our client throws "unexpected EOF". Were using the OpenAI-compatible endpoint with streaming enabled. Retrying usually works but UX is bad.

Attaching logs + HAR.

- Devon

---

From: Laura Bennett <laura@redwoodinference.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Ethan Park <ethan@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, Mar 11, 2026 at 4:41 PM
Subject: Fwd: Urgent: streaming responses dropping (Hosted API)

Fwd from Acme. This sounds like the SSE disconnects weve heard about. Please make sure were tracking + give them an ETA/workaround.

---

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwoodinference.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, Mar 11, 2026 at 5:10 PM
Subject: Re: Fwd: Urgent: streaming responses dropping (Hosted API)

Thanks. I opened/updated SUP-4821 and looped in Ethan + SRE. Workaround for now: retry when the stream terminates early; were investigating edge timeouts/buffering.

---

From: Ethan Park <ethan@redwoodinference.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura@redwoodinference.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, Mar 11, 2026 at 6:05 PM
Subject: Re: Fwd: Urgent: streaming responses dropping (Hosted API)

We have a likely fix (SSE route config). Planning to roll to us-east tonight if metrics look safe.
